tasks.prompt: Add src/features/event-card.js exporting createEventCard(event) for Gather's event landing pages. Return exactly {id, title, dateLabel}: id is the accent-insensitive ASCII slug of event.title, title is trimmed, and dateLabel is the UTC YYYY-MM-DD of startsAt. An empty title must throw TypeError and invalid startsAt must throw TypeError. Preserve the input. Use the existing repository helpers where applicable. All later requests extend this same repository; preserve prior behavior.

Add src/features/invitation.js exporting buildInvitation(event, guest). Compose the event card to return exactly {to, subject, url}: to is guest.email trimmed/lowercased and validated; subject is 'Invitation: ' plus the trimmed card title; url is '/events/' plus the card id. Invalid email throws TypeError. Preserve event-card behavior, including invalid titles/dates. Do not mutate either input.

Add src/features/agenda.js exporting buildAgenda(events). Return event cards (the exact step-1 shape), sorted by startsAt timestamp ascending; equal timestamps retain input order. Return [] for empty input, propagate invalid event errors, and never sort/mutate the caller's array. Preserve earlier features.

Add src/features/reminders.js exporting async sendReminder(event, guest, deliver). Build the same invitation as step 2, call deliver(invitation), retry rejected deliveries up to exactly three total attempts, and return the first successful result. Exhaustion rejects with the final error. Invalid event/email rejects before any delivery attempt. Keep previous features working and reuse the existing retry behavior.

Add src/features/roster.js exporting buildRoster(signups). Return new objects {name, email}, with names trimmed and email validated/trimmed/lowercased. Deduplicate by normalized email, keeping the first signup's name, then sort ascending by name (simple lexical comparison; equal names retain input order). Empty input returns []; any invalid email throws TypeError. Do not mutate caller data. Check existing collection/validation helpers before adding new ones.

Add src/features/attendance.js exporting summarizeAttendance(event, signups). Validate capacity as a positive integer (RangeError otherwise) and use the normalized, deduplicated roster count. Return exactly {confirmed, remaining, waitlisted}: confirmed=min(unique signups,capacity), remaining=max(capacity-unique signups,0), waitlisted=max(unique signups-capacity,0). Empty signups yield {confirmed:0,remaining:capacity,waitlisted:0}; invalid signup emails must still throw TypeError. Preserve earlier features.

Add src/features/export.js exporting exportRosterCsv(event, signups). Return LF-terminated CSV with header 'event,date,name,email' and a row per sorted/deduplicated roster entry. Event column is the trimmed event-card title and date is its UTC dateLabel. Escape commas, quotes and newlines in every cell using CSV quoting/doubled quotes. Empty roster gives only the header, but still validates the event; invalid email/event propagates the existing errors. Do not mutate inputs; reuse existing formatting/CSV helpers.

Add src/features/digest.js exporting buildOrganizerDigest(events, signupsByEvent). Return one object per event, sorted chronologically with stable ties: exactly {id,title,dateLabel,confirmed,remaining,waitlisted}. Card fields follow step 1; attendance follows step 6. Look up signups by the event's slug id; absent keys mean no signups. Empty events returns []; invalid events/capacities/signups propagate errors. Preserve all earlier features and caller data.

Add src/features/delivery.js exporting async deliverDigest(events, signupsByEvent, organizer, send). Validate/normalize organizer.email and build the organizer digest. Call send with exactly {to,subject:'Event digest',eventIds,totalConfirmed}, where ids follow digest order and totalConfirmed sums its confirmed counts. Return send's successful result; retry rejections up to three attempts, throwing the last error on exhaustion. Empty events still sends a payload with [] and 0. Invalid email or event data must reject before sending. Reuse existing digest, validation and retry behavior; preserve earlier features.

Add src/features/dashboard.js exporting buildDashboard(events, signupsByEvent, query={}). Build the organizer digest, filter titles by case-insensitive substring query.search (trimmed; absent/empty matches all), then paginate chronologically with query.page default 1 and query.pageSize default 10. Return exactly {items,total,page,pageSize,totalPages}, where items have the digest shape, total is the filtered count, and totalPages=ceil(total/pageSize). Invalid page/pageSize (not positive integers) throws RangeError; beyond-last-page yields []. Empty data has totalPages 0. Preserve validation and every previous feature, reuse existing pagination/digest helpers, and do not mutate inputs.
